column1: # Limits for the synthetic CC0 scenes on macOS (scripts/linux/scenes-check.sh --mac and the macOS CI job): photon-tool
# renders against Tests/scenes/refs-mac (Metal on an Apple GPU), 640x360, t = 2 s, PHOTON_SEED=1. Columns: id, max mean
# absolute per-channel difference, max pixels whose largest channel difference is > 32. Two renders on one Mac are
# byte-identical; another GPU generation (or the hosted runner's paravirtual GPU) may round differently, so the limits
# are the Metal-vs-lavapipe envelope (thresholds.tsv) rather than exact equality.
